egress.terms: 1 GB bandwidth per month on the free plan; paid tunnels are sold as unlimited bandwidth; ingress: udp
egress.free_allowance: 1 GB bandwidth per month on the free plan; paid tunnels are sold as unlimited bandwidth

record.interface_detail: localtonet --headless --authtoken-file, plus a web dashboard that creates the tunnel
record.tooling: localtonet client for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Docker
record.chaining: not composable: a 30-minute UDP port is not an endpoint any peer can keep in a config

limits.value: 30 min tunnel timeout on the free plan

record.binding_note: 1 GB is 0.0009 TiB; the 30-minute timeout would kill a WireGuard endpoint anyway, so two limits fail before the month is out.

identity_cost.detail: an account and an AuthToken per client: 'Select the AuthToken you entered in the Localtonet App' https://localtonet.com/documents/udp

record.reliability_note: free tunnels are dropped every 30 minutes and the public port can change on restart
record.confidence_note: The two failing numbers are on the vendor's own pricing block and in its own plan comparison; the community reply repeats the 30-minute figure.

evidence.proved: free plan: 1 HTTP/TCP/UDP tunnel, 1 GB bandwidth per month, 30 min tunnel timeout; paid plan: unlimited bandwidth, no tunnel timeout, custom domains and ports
'UDP tunnels allows you to expose any local network services running over UDP protocol', with an IP and port chosen per tunnel
vendor table: free plan 'Tunnel Server Port: May change on restart', paid 'Reserved'

record.notes: UDP is a first-class free protocol, which is why it was worth reading. Both the quota and the port stability disqualify it.

extras.wg_detail: the free plan's port is not fixed: the vendor's own comparison table gives the free plan 'Tunnel Server Port | May change on restart' and reserves a stable port for the paid plan
extras.volume_stated: 1 GB bandwidth per month on the free plan; paid tunnels are sold as unlimited bandwidth
extras.transit_note: the Localtonet relay carries the datagrams
